ListboxRoot.description: The list itself, with `role="listbox"`: it holds the selection, moves focus between the options and shares the state with the parts inside it. Label it with `aria-label` or `aria-labelledby`, or put it in a FieldRoot. With a `name`, or inside a FieldRoot, it renders hidden inputs beside the list so the value is submitted with its form.

props.value: The selected value: a string, or `null` for none; with `multiple`, a list of strings. Pass it with `onValueChange` to control the selection.
props.defaultValue: The value selected at first, when the selection isn't controlled: a string, or a list of strings with `multiple`. A form reset puts it back.
props.onValueChange: Called with the new value: a string with single selection, a list of strings with `multiple`. It runs in a change of its own, so a handler that saves to a server doesn't hold the list.
props.multiple: Whether any number of options may be selected. A click, Space and Enter then toggle an option, Shift+click and Shift+Space select a range, and Ctrl/Cmd+A selects them all.
props.disabled: Whether the list is disabled: no option can be selected or reached with Tab. A disabled FieldRoot around it disables it too.
props.required: Whether a value must be selected for the form to be valid.
props.name: The name the value is submitted under. With `multiple`, each selected value is submitted as its own entry. Inside a named FieldRoot, the field's name is used.

dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the list is disabled.

ListboxItem.description: An option, with `role="option"` and `aria-selected`. It takes real focus: style the focused option with `:focus-visible`. Its `tabindex` is written by the list, which keeps one option the Tab stop.

props.value: The value the option stands for: what is selected, reported and submitted.

dataAttributes.data-selected: Present while the option is selected.
dataAttributes.data-disabled: Present when the option, or the whole list, is disabled.
dataAttributes.data-label: The `label` prop, when given: the text typeahead matches.

ListboxItemText.description: The option's text, beside an indicator or other content. A plain `span`, for styling.

ListboxItemIndicator.description: Rendered while its option is selected, or always with `keepMounted`. It is hidden from assistive technology, which hears `aria-selected` instead.

props.keepMounted: Render it on every option, selected or not, and style the selected ones from `data-selected`: for a box that is filled when selected.

dataAttributes.data-selected: Present while its option is selected.

ListboxGroup.description: A set of related options, with `role="group"`, named by the ListboxGroupLabel inside it. The arrow keys run through groups as one list.

ListboxGroupLabel.description: The visible name of its group: the group's `aria-labelledby` points at it.
